changelog:
v3.1.0 — Closed Captions & Subtitle System

• CC button on player controls — toggle subtitles on/off instantly
• Remote CC key support (KEYCODE_CAPTIONS)
• Netflix-style subtitle rendering — bold outline text, no background box
• Subtitle preferences persist across sessions (language, size, style)
• Track Picker shows subtitle format badges (SRT, WebVTT, CC, DVB, SSA)
• Subtitle Settings page — customize text size, color, background, edge style
• CEA-608 closed caption detection for US IPTV streams
• Preferred language auto-selection on channel switch
